name: market-data-kafka-producer
description: High-performance Kafka producer for protobuf-serialized market data

phase-1-core.description: Consolidated topics, partition strategies, headers, configuration

phase-2-testing.description: Unit tests (6-8), integration tests (9), performance (10), backward compatibility (11)

phase-3-documentation.description: Consumer guides, migration guide, operator guide, migration CLI, monitoring

phase-4-tooling.description: Migration tooling (16), monitoring dashboard (17), producer tuning (19), troubleshooting runbook (19.1)

phase-5-migration.description: Blue-Green migration execution: Week 1 parallel deployment, Week 2 consumer validation, Week 3 gradual per-exchange migration, Week 4 stabilization, Weeks 5-6 legacy standby

tasks.success_criteria: 10 measurable targets (message loss zero, lag <5s, error rate <0.1%, latency p99 <5ms, throughput ≥100k msg/s, data integrity 100%, monitoring functional, rollback <5min, topic count O(20), headers 100%)

implementation_status.validation_method: Comprehensive 7-phase review (status, requirements, design, gap analysis, implementation, documentation, code quality)

execution_readiness.risks: LOW (5 identified risks, all with mitigations)
execution_readiness.review_scope: 7-phase comprehensive review (requirements, design, implementation, gap analysis, tests, documentation, code quality)
